# Put final version for itpce

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(glue)
library(here)

source(here::here("R/utils.R"))
source(here::here("R", "utils_viz.R"))
```

```{r}
itpc <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/Destrieux_final_itpc.csv")) |>
  dplyr::filter(type %in% c("prestim_itpc", "stim_itpc")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    S = dplyr::case_when(
      type == "prestim_itpc" ~ "prestim",
      type == "stim_itpc" ~ "stim",
      TRUE ~ type
    ),
    itpc = value
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(subject, roi, P, T, S, itpc) |>
  dplyr::distinct() #|>

print(itpc)

# Method 1: Compute differences FIRST, then average
itpc_diff <- itpc  %>%
  select(subject, roi, P, T, S, itpc) %>%
  # Aggregate within each subject×roi×P×T×S combination
  group_by(subject, roi, P, T, S) %>%
  summarise(
    itpc = mean(itpc, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Pivot to wide format
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = S,
    values_from = c(itpc),
        names_prefix = "itpc_"

  ) %>%
  # Compute WITHIN-SUBJECT differences
  mutate(
    itpc_diff = itpc_stim - itpc_prestim
  )

# ITPC plot
p_itpc <- plot_condition_comparison(
  data = itpc_diff,
  metric = "itpc",
  metric_label = "ITPC"
)
p_itpc

```




# Change in aperiodic exponent



```{r}


specparam <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/specparam_all.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(S = condition) %>%
  select(subject, roi, P, T, S, exponent, error, offset) %>%
  distinct()
print(specparam)

# Method 1: Compute differences FIRST, then average
specparam_diff <- specparam %>%
  select(subject, roi, P, T, S, exponent, offset) %>%
  # Aggregate within each subject×roi×P×T×S combination
  group_by(subject, roi, P, T, S) %>%
  summarise(
    exponent = mean(exponent, na.rm = TRUE),
    offset = mean(offset, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Pivot to wide format
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = S,
    values_from = c(exponent, offset)
  ) %>%
  # Compute WITHIN-SUBJECT differences
  mutate(
    exponent_diff = exponent_stim - exponent_prestim,
    offset_diff = offset_stim - offset_prestim
  )

head(specparam_diff)


# Exponent plot
p_exponent <- plot_condition_comparison(
  data = specparam_diff,
  metric = "exponent",
  metric_label = "Aperiodic Exponent"
)
p_exponent

# Offset plot
p_offset <- plot_condition_comparison(
  data = specparam_diff,
  metric = "offset",
  metric_label = "Spectral Offset"
)
p_offset
# metrics <- metrics_to_plot


```

```{r}
# check current PATH and whether RBA is visible
Sys.getenv("PATH")
Sys.which("RBA")

cand <- c(
  file.path(Sys.getenv("HOME"), "abin"),
  "/usr/local/bin",
  "/opt/homebrew/bin", # Apple Silicon Homebrew
  "/usr/local/afni/bin", # generic
  Sys.getenv("CONDA_PREFIX")
) # if installed via conda

cand <- cand[file.exists(cand)]
Sys.setenv(PATH = paste(c(cand, Sys.getenv("PATH")), collapse = .Platform$path.sep))
Sys.which("RBA") # should now show a path
```
# Running RBA

```{r}
# Now average the differences (not the conditions separately)
specparam_avg <- specparam_diff %>%
  group_by(subject, roi) %>%
  summarise(
    # Keep individual conditions for plotting
    exponent_prestim = mean(exponent_prestim, na.rm = TRUE),
    exponent_stim = mean(exponent_stim, na.rm = TRUE),
    offset_prestim = mean(offset_prestim, na.rm = TRUE),
    offset_stim = mean(offset_stim, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Mean of differences (correct for paired data!)
    exponent_diff = mean(exponent_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    offset_diff = mean(offset_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_pairs = n(), # How many P×T combinations
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Verify the difference
specparam_avg %>%
  mutate(
    # This should equal exponent_diff (it does!)
    check = exponent_stim - exponent_prestim
  ) %>%
  select(subject, roi, exponent_diff, check) %>%
  head()
```


```{r}
# assumes you already have: itpc_wide with columns: subject, roi, prestim, stim
specparam_rba_diff <- specparam_avg %>%
  transmute(
    Subj = subject,
    ROI  = roi,
    Y    = (exponent_prestim + exponent_stim) / 2
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(Y)

write.table(
  specparam_rba_diff,
  file = "specparam_rba_exponent.tsv",
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, na = "NA"
)


read.delim("specparam_rba_exponent.tsv") %>% dplyr::glimpse()
```


```{r}
# 0) sanity checks
model_name <- "specparam_rba_exponent"
data_table_file <- glue("{model_name}.tsv")
stopifnot(file.exists(data_table_file)) # Subj ROI Y
system("RBA -help | head -n 5") # confirm it's on PATH


# 1) run RBA (blocking; prints to the notebook)
cmd <- paste(
  "RBA",
  glue("-prefix models/{model_name}"),
  "-chains 4",
  "-iterations 5000",
  "-model 1",
  "-EOI 'Intercept'",
  " -ridgePlot 10 8 ",
  "-distY 'normal'", # robust if your Y has outliers
  "-dataTable ",
  data_table_file
)
status <- system(cmd)
fs::file_move("Intercept_ridge.png", glue("models/", model_name, "_", "intercept_ridge.png"))

# 2) read results back into R
# res <- read.delim("specparam_exponent_rba.txt", comment.char = "#")
# head(res)
```


```{r}
e <- new.env()
load(here::here(glue("notebooks/models/{model_name}.RData")), envir = e)

ls(e) # see what's inside
spectral_offset_sigma <- e$fm # pull just the object(s) you want
# model <- e$model
# 1. Extract S effects for each ROI
# Note: In your model, S is a factor with levels "prestim" and "stim"
# The parameter name will be "Sstim" (contrast against baseline)


# Extract ONLY the Intercept effects (the only population-level effect in your model)
intercept_effects <- extract_region_effects(
  fit = spectral_offset_sigma,
  region_var = "ROI", # Use "ROI" (capital) - RBA default
  parameter = "Intercept",
  digits = 4
)

# Create results dataframe
results_df <- data.frame(
  roi = rownames(intercept_effects),
  mean_effect = intercept_effects$mean,
  sd = intercept_effects$SD,
  p_plus = intercept_effects$`P+`,
  lower95 = intercept_effects$`2.5%`,
  upper95 = intercept_effects$`97.5%`
) %>%
  mutate(
    significant = (lower95 > 0) | (upper95 < 0),
    effect_direction = case_when(
      mean_effect > 0 ~ "increase",
      mean_effect < 0 ~ "decrease",
      TRUE ~ "no_change"
    )
  )

head(results_df) %>%
  mutate(roi = case_when(
    roi == "lh_Medial_wall" ~ "lh_medial_wall",
    roi == "rh_Medial_wall" ~ "rh_medial_wall",
    TRUE ~ roi
  ))


# Don't strip the hemisphere prefix - keep the original ROI names!
viz_df <- results_df %>%
  dplyr::rename(label = roi) %>% # atlas expects 'label', not 'region'
  dplyr::select(label, mean_effect)

# Now the plot should work
p_mean_all <- my_brain_plot(
  df = viz_df,
  atlas_df = desterieux,
  parameter = mean_effect,
  filltype = "Blues",
  legend = TRUE
) +
  ggtitle("Exponent across the scalp")

p_mean_all
```

## Offset

```{r}
# assumes you already have: itpc_wide with columns: subject, roi, prestim, stim
offset_rba_diff <- specparam_avg %>%
  transmute(
    Subj = subject,
    ROI  = roi,
    Y    = (offset_prestim + offset_stim) / 2
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(Y)

offset_data_file <- "specparam_rba_offset.tsv"

write.table(
  offset_rba_diff,
  file = offset_data_file,
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, na = "NA"
)



read.delim(offset_data_file) %>% dplyr::glimpse()
```

```{r}
# 0) sanity checks
model_name <- "specparam_rba_offset"
data_table_file <- glue("{model_name}.tsv")
stopifnot(file.exists(data_table_file)) # Subj ROI Y
system("RBA -help | head -n 5") # confirm it's on PATH


# 1) run RBA (blocking; prints to the notebook)
cmd <- paste(
  "RBA",
  glue("-prefix models/{model_name}"),
  "-chains 4",
  "-iterations 5000",
  "-model 1",
  "-EOI 'Intercept'",
  " -ridgePlot 10 8 ",
  "-distY 'normal'", # robust if your Y has outliers
  "-dataTable ",
  data_table_file
)
status <- system(cmd)
src <- "Intercept_ridge.png"
if (fs::file_exists(src)) {
  fs::file_move(src, glue("models/", model_name, "_", "intercept_ridge.png"))
} else {
  warning(glue("Source missing: {src}. Nothing moved."))
}
# 2) read results back into R
# res <- read.delim("specparam_exponent_rba.txt", comment.char = "#")
# head(res)
```
